```{r}
MODEL_data_new <- read_tsv("ALL_Combined_10082026.tsv", col_names = TRUE)
```

```{r}
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)
library(ggpubr)
library(rstatix)

# =========================
# RNA group comparison plot
# =========================

group_order <- c(
  "C_H_M_H",
  "C_H_M_L",
  "C_L_M_H",
  "C_L_M_L"
)

data_all <- MODEL_data_new %>%
  select(Group, RNA_RPKM) %>%
  filter(
    !is.na(Group),
    !is.na(RNA_RPKM)
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    Group = factor(
      Group,
      levels = group_order
    )
  )

# =========================
# Group means + SD
# =========================

data_summary <- data_all %>%
  group_by(Group) %>%
  summarise(
    Average_Score = mean(RNA_RPKM, na.rm = TRUE),
    SD = sd(RNA_RPKM, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

print(data_summary)


# =========================
# Overall Kruskal-Wallis test
# =========================

kw <- kruskal_test(
  data_all,
  RNA_RPKM ~ Group
)

print(kw)


# =========================
# Pairwise Wilcoxon tests
# =========================

pairwise_res <- data_all %>%
  pairwise_wilcox_test(
    RNA_RPKM ~ Group,
    p.adjust.method = "fdr"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    p_label = case_when(
      p.adj < 0.0001 ~ "****",
      p.adj < 0.001  ~ "***",
      p.adj < 0.01   ~ "**",
      p.adj < 0.05   ~ "*",
      TRUE           ~ "ns"
    )
  )

print(pairwise_res)


# =========================
# Dynamic y positions
# =========================

plot_max <- max(
  data_summary$Average_Score + data_summary$SD,
  na.rm = TRUE
)

step_size <- plot_max * 0.12

pairwise_res$y.position <- plot_max +
  step_size * seq_len(nrow(pairwise_res))


# =========================
# Plot
# =========================

p <- ggplot(
  data_summary,
  aes(
    x = Group,
    y = Average_Score,
    fill = Group
  )
) +

  geom_col(
    width = 0.6,
    color = "black"
  ) +

  geom_errorbar(
    aes(
      ymin = pmax(Average_Score - SD, 0),
      ymax = Average_Score + SD
    ),
    width = 0.2,
    linewidth = 0.8
  ) +

  geom_text(
    aes(
      label = sprintf("%.2f", Average_Score)
    ),
    vjust = -0.4,
    size = 5
  ) +

  stat_pvalue_manual(
    pairwise_res,
    label = "p_label",
    xmin = "group1",
    xmax = "group2",
    y.position = "y.position",
    tip.length = 0.01,
    bracket.size = 0.5,
    size = 5,
    inherit.aes = FALSE
  ) +

  annotate(
    "text",
    x = 1.5,
    y = max(pairwise_res$y.position) + step_size,
    label = paste0(
      "Kruskal-Wallis, p = ",
      signif(kw$p, 3)
    ),
    size = 5,
    hjust = 0
  ) +

  scale_fill_manual(
    values = c(
      "C_H_M_H" = "#F28C9D",
      "C_H_M_L" = "#F3E065",
      "C_L_M_H" = "#65C9F3",
      "C_L_M_L" = "#9EAAE0"
    )
  ) +

  scale_y_continuous(
    limits = c(
      0,
      max(pairwise_res$y.position) + step_size * 2
    ),
    expand = c(0, 0)
  ) +

  labs(
    title = "RNA Expression Across Groups",
    x = "Group",
    y = "RNA Expression Level (RPKM)"
  ) +

  theme_classic(base_size = 14) +

  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(
      angle = 45,
      hjust = 1
    ),
    panel.border = element_rect(
      color = "black",
      fill = NA,
      linewidth = 1
    ),
    plot.title = element_text(
      hjust = 0.5,
      face = "bold"
    ),
    legend.position = "none"
  )

print(p)
```

```{r}
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)
library(ggpubr)

# =========================
# RNA average expression barplot
# directly from MODEL_data_new
# =========================

group_order <- c(
  "C_H_M_H",
  "C_H_M_L",
  "C_L_M_H",
  "C_L_M_L"
)

data_summary <- MODEL_data_new %>%
  select(Group, RNA_RPKM) %>%
  filter(
    !is.na(Group),
    !is.na(RNA_RPKM)
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    Group = factor(
      Group,
      levels = group_order
    )
  ) %>%
  group_by(Group) %>%
  summarise(
    Average_Score = mean(RNA_RPKM, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

print(data_summary)


# =========================
# Y-axis range
# =========================

y_max <- max(
  data_summary$Average_Score,
  na.rm = TRUE
) * 1.15


# =========================
# Plot
# =========================

p <- ggbarplot(
  data_summary,
  x = "Group",
  y = "Average_Score",
  fill = "Group",
  width = 0.6,
  label = sprintf(
    "%.2f",
    data_summary$Average_Score
  ),
  label.pos = "out",
  lab.vjust = -0.5,
  palette = c(
    "#F28C9D",
    "#F3E065",
    "#65C9F3",
    "#9EAAE0"
  )
) +

  scale_y_continuous(
    limits = c(0, y_max),
    expand = c(0, 0)
  ) +

  labs(
    title = "RNA Average Expression",
    x = "Group",
    y = "Average RNA Expression (RPKM)"
  ) +

  theme_classic(base_size = 14) +

  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(
      angle = 45,
      hjust = 1
    ),
    panel.border = element_rect(
      color = "black",
      fill = NA,
      linewidth = 1
    ),
    plot.title = element_text(
      hjust = 0.5,
      face = "bold"
    ),
    legend.position = "none"
  )

print(p)
```
